text:
Predicates:
Engaged(x) ::: x is engaged.
MakeWeddingPlans(x) ::: x makes wedding plans.
Invite(x, y) ::: x invites y to the ceremony.
Wedding(x) ::: x has a wedding.
WellAttended(x) ::: x has a well-attended wedding.
LargerFamily(x) ::: x has a larger family.
Premises:
∀x (MakeWeddingPlans(x) → Engaged(x)) ::: All people who make wedding plans are engaged.
∀x (Invite(x, y) → MakeWeddingPlans(x)) ::: All people who invite others to their ceremony make wedding plans.
∀x (WellAttended(x) → Invite(x, y)) ::: Anyone with a well-attended wedding invites others to the ceremony.
∀x (LargerFamily(x) → (Wedding(x) ∨ Invite(x, y))) ::: People with larger families have a well-attended wedding or invite friends.
If(Engaged(John)) ¬Invite(John, y) ∧ MakeWeddingPlans(John) ::: If John is engaged, then he does not invite friends and makes wedding plans.
If(LargerFamily(John)) → (WellAttended(John) ∨ Invite(John, y)) ::: If John has a larger family, then he has a well-attended wedding or invites friends.
Conclusion:
LargerFamily(John) ::: John has a larger family.
